definitions.explanation: Reserved for a particular person, purpose, or function. Used as a no-adjective to modify nouns: {専用|せんよう}の~ (dedicated ~).

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧{専用|せんよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a parking space reserved for the company president.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧{専用|せんよう}です。
examples.english: This app is for members only.

examples.japanese: {女性|じょせい}{専用|せんよう}{車両|しゃりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦ラッシュ→ラッシュ：11221_rasshu⟧⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{設|もう}けられている→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: Women-only train cars are provided during the morning commute rush.

notes:
USAGE:
{専用|せんよう} is extremely common in daily life, appearing on signs, labels, and in instructions. It functions primarily as a no-adjective or prefix: {専用|せんよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～ or ～{専用|せんよう} (dedicated to ~). It can also be used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb meaning "to use exclusively."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～{専用|せんよう}: dedicated to ~, exclusively for ~ (e.g., {子|こ}ども{専用|せんよう} — for children only)
- {専用|せんよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～: dedicated ~ (e.g., {専用|せんよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧ — dedicated tools)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧{専用|せんよう}: women-only
- ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧{専用|せんよう}: members-only
- {専用|せんよう}{機|き}: dedicated device/aircraft
- {専用|せんよう}⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧: dedicated line
- {専用|せんよう}⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧: dedicated app
